title: Olympiad-level formal mathematical reasoning with reinforcement learning
authors_zh: Thomas Hubert, Rishi Mehta, Laurent Sartran, Miklós Z. Horváth, Goran Žužić, Eric Wieser, Aja Huang, Julian Schrittwieser, Yannick Schroecker, Hussain Masoom, Ottavia Bertolli, Tom Zahavy, Amol Mandhane, Jessica Yung, Iuliya Beloshapka, Borja Ibarz, Vivek Veeriah, Lei Yu, Oliver Nash, Paul Lezeau, Salvatore Mercuri, Calle Sönne, Bhavik Mehta, Alex Davies, Daniel Zheng, Fabian Pedregosa, Yin Li, Ingrid von Glehn, Mark Rowland, Samuel Albanie, Ameya Velingker, Simon Schmitt, Edward Lockhart, Edward Hughes, Henryk Michalewski, Nicolas Sonnerat, Demis Hassabis, Pushmeet Kohli, David Silver
paper_type_zh: Rollout、搜索或测试时推理轨迹研究
best_for_zh: 需要审计测试时轨迹、反馈与选择机制的读者
one_line: Olympiad-level formal mathematical reasoning with reinforcement learning records Lean tactic-state search and verified proof/disproof outcomes under Lean checker feedback.
AlphaProof 在 Lean 中以树搜索和测试时强化学习构造可验证证明经验，但核心课程与搜索日志未公开。
why: It makes budgeted tree search with replay of discovered proofs/disproofs and its audit boundary visible for reasoning-data curation.
inclusion_reason: Approved Track 5 candidate with a concrete feedback/selection object: Lean tactic-state search and verified proof/disproof outcomes.

title: Problem
问题
html:
AlphaProof targets elite formal mathematics in Lean, where an agent must choose tactics from a large open-ended action space and solve all generated subgoals under a finite compute budget. For reasoning-data curation, the relevant object is not only a final verified proof: it is the sequence of pretty-printed tactic states, sampled tactics, Lean transitions, proof/disproof/timeout outcomes, tree-search statistics, and replay-selection decisions.

The work addresses two data bottlenecks. Human-written Lean proofs are too small for broad RL curricula, so a Gemini-based auto-formalizer expands informal problems into formal statements. Hard target problems then receive problem-specific test-time reinforcement learning (TTRL) over generated variants. The paper documents this recipe, but the main synthetic curricula, replay buffer, failed search attempts, and trained model are not released as an open data package.

AlphaProof 面向 Lean 中的高水平形式数学：智能体需要在巨大的开放动作空间中选择 tactic，在有限计算预算内解决所有生成的子目标。对推理数据策展而言，数据对象不只是最终通过验证的证明，还包括 pretty-printed tactic state、采样 tactic、Lean 状态转移、proof/disproof/timeout 结果、树搜索统计和 replay 选择决策。

该工作处理两类数据瓶颈。人工编写的 Lean 证明规模不足以支撑广泛 RL 课程，因此系统用基于 Gemini 的 auto-formalizer 将非形式问题扩展为形式陈述；困难目标问题再通过相关变体进行问题特定的 test-time reinforcement learning（TTRL）。论文记录了该配方，但主要合成课程、replay buffer、失败搜索尝试和训练后模型并未作为开放数据包发布。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html:
AlphaProof casts Lean tactic mode as an RL environment. A state is the complete logical context of hypotheses and goals, the observation is its string rendering, an action is a Lean tactic, and the transition is Lean's execution result. Episodes end with a kernel-verified proof or when the compute budget is exhausted; actors may also be assigned to disprove a statement. Each tactic receives reward −1, so the return favors short longest proof branches while handling AND nodes with multiple subgoals.

A 3B encoder–decoder proof network proposes tactics and estimates value for an AlphaZero/Sampled-MuZero-style tree search. Main RL learns from successful proofs and disproofs stored in replay; failed attempts are filtered from network updates. TTRL generates a bespoke curriculum of related formal variants for a hard target and runs focused RL/search adaptation at inference time.

AlphaProof 把 Lean tactic mode 建模为 RL 环境。状态是由假设和目标构成的完整逻辑上下文，观察是其字符串表示，动作是 Lean tactic，转移由 Lean 执行结果给出。episode 以 kernel 验证通过的证明结束，或在计算预算耗尽时终止；actor 也可能被分配去否证一个陈述。每个 tactic 的奖励为 −1，因此 return 倾向于缩短最长证明分支，并能处理含多个子目标的 AND node。

一个 3B encoder–decoder proof network 为 AlphaZero/Sampled-MuZero 风格树搜索提出 tactic 并估计 value。Main RL 从存入 replay 的成功证明与否证中学习，失败尝试不会进入网络更新。TTRL 则为困难目标生成相关形式变体的专属课程，在推理时进行聚焦的 RL/搜索适应。

title: Method
方法
html:
Training begins with next-token pretraining on about 300B tokens of code and mathematical text, followed by SFT on about 300K Mathlib state–tactic pairs. A Gemini-based formalization model, refined with human and synthetic data, auto-formalizes roughly one million informal problems into about 80 million valid Lean statements. A matchmaker assigns statements, adaptive budgets, and prove/disprove roles to distributed actors; proof-network-guided AND–OR tree search samples and validates tactics in Lean.

Proofs, disproofs, and timeouts provide environment feedback. The learner samples 10% Mathlib SFT pairs and 90% actor-generated proof/disproof replay, training the policy by tactic cross-entropy and the value head on returns; failed attempts are excluded. For TTRL, a variant generator builds relevant formal variants and focused RL adapts the prover to the target. Final proofs are independently checked with the Lean command-line tool and restricted to three accepted built-in axioms. Exact released replay contents are unavailable.

训练先在约 300B token 的代码与数学文本上进行 next-token 预训练，再用约 300K 条 Mathlib state–tactic pair 做 SFT。一个以人工和合成数据迭代改进的 Gemini-based formalization model，将约一百万道非形式问题自动形式化为约八千万个有效 Lean 陈述。matchmaker 为分布式 actor 分配陈述、自适应预算以及证明/否证角色；由 proof network 引导的 AND–OR 树搜索在 Lean 中采样并验证 tactic。

Proof、disproof 和 timeout 提供环境反馈。learner 按 10% Mathlib SFT pair 与 90% actor 生成 proof/disproof replay 的固定比例采样，以 tactic cross-entropy 训练 policy，并用 return 训练 value head；失败尝试被排除。TTRL 使用 variant generator 构造相关形式变体，并以聚焦 RL 适配目标问题。最终证明由 Lean 命令行工具独立复核，并限制为三个公认的内置公理。实际发布的 replay 内容仍不可得。

title: Evidence
证据
html:
The Nature article directly documents the Lean state/action/reward contract, model and tree search, 300K-pair SFT set, approximately 80M-statement main-RL curriculum, replay mixture, TTRL variant curriculum, and independent proof verification. Its data-availability statement links corrected miniF2F and formal-imo benchmarks and a pinned PutnamBench source; supplementary material includes algorithm pseudocode and hyperparameters. The synthetic curricula and RL proof replay are described as system-generated, not released.

At IMO 2024, AlphaProof solved three of five non-geometry problems after expert formalization and multi-day TTRL; AlphaGeometry 2 solved the geometry problem, giving the combined system 28/42. This supports the effectiveness of the documented method under substantial compute. It does not prove that every auto-formalization is faithful to its informal source or that the hidden replay buffer is reusable, representative, or contamination-free.

Nature 论文直接记录了 Lean 的 state/action/reward 契约、模型与树搜索、300K pair 的 SFT 集、约八千万陈述的 main-RL 课程、replay 混合、TTRL 变体课程和独立证明验证。其 data availability 说明链接了修正后的 miniF2F、formal-imo 基准及固定版本的 PutnamBench；补充材料提供算法伪代码和超参数。合成课程和 RL proof replay 被描述为系统生成，但未发布。

在 IMO 2024 上，AlphaProof 在专家形式化后通过多日 TTRL 解出五道非几何题中的三道；AlphaGeometry 2 解出几何题，使组合系统获得 28/42。这支持该方法在大量计算下的有效性，但不能证明每个 auto-formalization 都忠实于非形式来源，也不能证明隐藏 replay buffer 可复用、有代表性或无污染。

title: Novelty
新意
html:
Lean verification, tactic prediction, neural tree search, expert iteration, and auto-formalization all predate AlphaProof. The distinctive combination is scale and routing: tens of millions of valid formal statements form a broad AlphaZero-like RL curriculum, successful proof/disproof experience updates both policy and value, and hard targets trigger a separate TTRL loop over generated problem variants.

For the rollout/search track, the important novelty is that inference compute can create a temporary, target-specific training dataset rather than merely sample more final answers. The paper also makes the selector visible: Lean validates transitions and final proof objects, while the learner admits successful proofs/disproofs and filters failed attempts. This is a direction signal for auditable test-time adaptation, not an open trace release.

Lean 验证、tactic prediction、神经树搜索、expert iteration 和 auto-formalization 都早于 AlphaProof。其独特组合在于规模与路由：数千万有效形式陈述组成广泛的 AlphaZero-like RL 课程，成功 proof/disproof 经验同时更新 policy 与 value，而困难目标会触发一个基于生成问题变体的独立 TTRL 循环。

对 rollout/search 分类而言，重要新意是推理计算可以生成临时的、目标特定训练数据，而不只是多采样几个最终答案。论文也明确了 selector：Lean 验证状态转移和最终证明对象，learner 接收成功证明/否证并过滤失败尝试。这是可审计测试时适应的方向信号，而不是开放轨迹发布。

title: Limitations
局限
html:
The approximately 80M formal statements need only be valid Lean problems; the paper explicitly notes that fidelity to the original informal statement is not required for use as RL training. The source mixture for the one million informal problems, duplicates, rights, formalization-error distribution, and contamination controls are not fully exposed. Failed attempts are filtered from learning, obscuring candidate attrition and failure structure.

The main synthetic curriculum, TTRL variants, replay buffer, actor logs, trained weights, matchmaker statistics, and full distributed environment are not released. Although pseudocode and hyperparameters are available, the bespoke training scale is beyond most academic groups, and TTRL takes multiple days on the hardest problems. Success is concentrated in competition mathematics within a fixed library; alternative proof diversity, transfer to research mathematics, and replay reproducibility remain open.

约八千万形式陈述只需成为有效 Lean 问题；论文明确说明，作为 RL 训练实例时并不要求它们忠实于原始非形式陈述。约一百万道非形式问题的来源混合、重复、权利、形式化错误分布和污染控制未被完整公开。失败尝试被排除在学习之外，导致候选淘汰和失败结构不可见。

主要合成课程、TTRL 变体、replay buffer、actor 日志、训练后权重、matchmaker 统计和完整分布式环境均未发布。虽然伪代码和超参数可得，但定制训练规模超出多数研究团队能力，最困难问题的 TTRL 还需数日。成功主要集中于固定库中的竞赛数学；替代证明多样性、向研究数学迁移和 replay 可复现性仍是开放问题。

title: Usefulness
用途
html:
For rollout_search_test_time_trace_data, AlphaProof supplies a precise schema for what a formal-search record should preserve: formal statement and provenance, Lean/Mathlib version, tactic state, sampled tactic, validity and execution result, resulting subgoals, per-step reward, tree visits and values, adaptive budget, proof/disproof/timeout outcome, replay inclusion, and final independent verification.

The TTRL loop is especially relevant to post-training data design because it turns generated variants and verified search experience into problem-specific adaptation at inference time. Reuse or replication requires releasing the curriculum, accepted and rejected attempts, tree and matchmaker logs, replay sampling, environment pins, model checkpoints, and compute accounting. Benchmark results alone are method evidence, not trace-quality proof.

对 rollout_search_test_time_trace_data 而言，AlphaProof 给出了一套明确的形式搜索记录模式：形式陈述及溯源、Lean/Mathlib 版本、tactic state、采样 tactic、有效性与执行结果、生成的子目标、逐步奖励、树访问与 value、自适应预算、proof/disproof/timeout 结果、是否进入 replay，以及最终独立验证。

TTRL 循环对后训练数据设计尤其重要，因为它在推理时把生成变体和已验证搜索经验转化为问题特定适应。复用或复现需要发布课程、接受与拒绝尝试、树和 matchmaker 日志、replay 采样、环境固定版本、模型检查点及计算核算。基准结果只是方法证据，不是轨迹质量证明。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html:
• Track state–tactic transitions, proof/disproof/timeout outcomes, budgets, and replay inclusion as separate fields.
  • Distinguish the 300K Mathlib SFT pairs, approximately 80M formal RL statements, and target-specific TTRL variants.
  • Note that failed attempts are filtered from network updates and the replay buffer is not released.
  • Treat IMO and benchmark results as evidence for the compute-intensive method, not proof of data fidelity or openness.

• 将 state–tactic 转移、proof/disproof/timeout 结果、预算和 replay 纳入情况记录为不同字段。
  • 区分 300K 条 Mathlib SFT pair、约八千万形式 RL 陈述和目标特定 TTRL 变体。
  • 注意失败尝试不会进入网络更新，且 replay buffer 未发布。
  • 将 IMO 与基准结果视为计算密集方法的证据，而不是数据忠实性或开放性的证明。
